title: Literal evaluation
statement: For a dimension $n$, let a literal specify a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a required sign $r\in\{\pm1\}$. On an input $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, its value is $-1$ if $x_i=r$, and $+1$ otherwise.
